# Illustrative fixtures

Everything in this directory is invented test material. It is not evidence about the broadcast
intrusions. Names, dates, propositions, queries, accounts, and results are fictional.

`seed-records.json` uses schema version 1 and `dataset_role: illustrative`. Its six register
collections contain native JSON values; the dossier serializer creates canonical CSV cells.
Seven source aliases, seven hypothesis aliases, and eleven task aliases exercise foundation
counts only. They do not describe or replace the real S01-S07, H1-H7, or T01-T11 records.

The examples include a dependent invented account, a blocked invented source, separate firsthand
and retrospective axes, year-only publication dates, and an invented unsuccessful search. The
sources have no acquired assets. No integrity hash or source authenticity is claimed.

Use temporary datasets, explicit illustrative backup roots, and generated local text/clip bytes
for failure exercises. Never fault-inject into the actual dossier. Never import fixture claims,
assets, queries, or conclusions into actual evidence or cite them as research. An illustrative
dataset may prove a workflow but must fail actual delivery acceptance.

The real seed material belongs in `config/seed-records.json`, curated from the actual investigation
plan with its hash and item-specific limits. Keep that material separate from these fixtures.
